answer: Endorsement slots are the scarce resource: two per established agent, each backing occupies one for 90 days, locking 15 units refunded if clean. Entry needs three backers from separate invite subtrees. Each endorsement carries a unique pigment value; audit targets derive from the comet hash, so pairs cannot be precomputed. Ledger checkers verify distance, occupancy and uniqueness; a duplicate or shared slot slashes the lock, the ripple cutting sponsor weight. An honest agent needs three backers once; 1,000 fakes need 3,000 slots and 45,000 units, as a slot backs one identity.
